subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which open raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path after proof and serialization blockers are addressed?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 both target the same canonical issue, and automation should not choose between two proof-gated candidate branches without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate if it adopts total serialization, adds non-JSON regression coverage, and receives accessible live app-server/plugin proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader normalization shape after proof and CI are reviewable.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader normalization shape after proof and CI are reviewable.
